title: Vendor query $select uses `dcfg_trade` but rest of SPA uses `dcfg_trades` (plural)
detail: Line 68: `&$select=...,dcfg_trade,dcfg_primary_contact` -- singular `dcfg_trade`. Line 72 reads `r.dcfg_trade`. But VendorList.jsx:74 also uses `dcfg_trade` in $select, then line 138 reads `v.dcfg_trades || v.dcfg_trade` -- showing the author was uncertain. MsaList.jsx:62, portalApi.js fetchVendors (if it exists) and other places reference `dcfg_trades`. Only one of the two names is correct. If `dcfg_trades` is the actual schema (comma-separated list per ProjectList.jsx:25 TRADES list), then Directory shows '' for every vendor (field not returned, fallback to empty string).
evidence: Directory.jsx:68, 72. VendorList.jsx:74, 138. Inconsistent usage across files.
recommendedFix: Verify via Dataverse EntityDefinition which column actually exists on dcfg_vendor. Update Directory.jsx to match -- most likely `dcfg_trades` is the correct name. Cross-check with the Database Bible (`reference_database_bible.json`).

title: Directory imports usePortalUser but never uses it
detail: Line 9: `import { usePortalUser } from '../usePortalUser.jsx';` -- never called anywhere in the file.

title: Directory data load has bare .catch(function() { setLoading(false); }) -- no error surface
detail: Line 82: `.catch(function() { setLoading(false); });` -- if the vendors or customers query fails (network, permissions, 403), loading stops but no error message is shown. The user sees an empty directory with 'No contacts found.' and has no way to know the load failed vs. the system being genuinely empty.
evidence: Directory.jsx:82 -- bare catch with no error state or toast.
recommendedFix: Add an error state: `var _e2 = useState(null); var error = _e2[0]; var setError = _e2[1];` and in catch: `setError('Failed to load contacts'); setLoading(false);`. Render error above results.
